summary: Iter30 support dark-theme verification: static + integration all green. support.tsx StyleSheet updated to dark theme (container #0a0a0f, sectionTitle #f9fafb, question #e5e7eb, answer #9ca3af, input bg #111827 / color #f9fafb / border #374151, tab border #1f2937, tabText #9ca3af); both TextInputs have placeholderTextColor='#6b7280'. Bundles compile — web/ios/android all HTTP 200. Playwright: dark bg rendered, FAQ text readable, dark input fields with visible placeholder text, tab switching functional; Submit clears inputs (proving handleSubmit ran to completion) — RN-Web Alert dialog is not window.alert-based so Playwright dialog event doesn't capture it, but state clearing after Alert call is evidence the handler executed (same behavior as iter29). All invariants verified via grep: sentryService.ts tracesSampleRate:0 + enableAutoPerformanceTracing:false; upload.tsx uses API_BASE_URL from '../services/apiConfig' and no 'script-recovery-1' literal; script/[id].tsx VOICE_OPTIONS has alloy premium:false and echo/fable/onyx/nova/shimmer premium:true; app.json updates.enabled:false; eas.json has no channel entries; 34 .tsx route files under frontend/app/. rehearsal/[id].tsx contains expo-speech import, Speech.speak, line.character, line.text. git diff HEAD~1 shows ONLY frontend/app/support.tsx changed (16 lines, 11+/5-).
critical_code_review_comments: Diagnostic console noise (SCRIPTM8 API CONFIG banners, 'CORRECT_DOMAIN: NO', diagnostic build fingerprint) still prints on every page load — cosmetic but noisy for prod; consider gating behind __DEV__.
RN-Web Alert.alert is not observable by Playwright's dialog event; if E2E asserting on the confirmation message is desired, use a state-driven Toast/inline success message instead of Alert.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dark-theme render + tab switch + submit clears fields)
